text: Delivered on local main (unpushed) through af1347c; plan docs/plans/2026-10-02-interaction-04-svg-widget.md. Commits: c1d5842 behaviour/content/links, 78d4e17 plot parts + coverage matrix, 0cdfa08 shared HostInput/TooltipLayout, bb23791 SVG id prefixes, 420326d browser widget + fixture + Playwright check, 7c02890 docs/CHANGELOG/compat, 1d74fcd + af1347c fixes for 11 findings of an independent review. Criteria: (1) tooltips pointer/anchored/fixed, delay (pointer only), CSS-variable styling, focus access, text-only content; (2) typed targets for marks and PlotParts (legend entries/titles, colorbars incl. title, facet strips, axes, titles, annotations), InteractionCoverage matrix enforced by test; (3) update/subscribe/dispose, 25 remount cycles return listener + ResizeObserver counts to baseline; (4) per-widget id prefixes, duplicate prefix refused, typed EventRecord/PartEvent callbacks; (5) one tab stop + table toggle, roving keys, focus ring + halo, live region, collapsible text companion, reduced motion. Evidence: full gate at 7c02890 (testAll 16 targets/1938, docs, compat exit 0); real browser Chromium 151.0.7922.34 15/15 checks with 1x/2x screenshots reviewed. Not established: screen-reader (AT) testing, touch emulation beyond pointer events, colorbar position-to-value mapping, legend entries carry level labels not typed scale values, companion table not virtualized. Closing.
